derivation: The Hermite Kramers matrix has correct velocity-advection, force, and temperature-diffusion ladder coefficients after multiplying the stationary equation by mass. Stratonovich-to-Ito conversion yields gamma/m integral[T0(c0+sqrt(2)c2)/T-c0], including the heat-noise subtraction. The three-mass coefficients 1/3,-2,8/3 cancel the first two powers of mass.
analytic_limit: At force=0, normalized position density is proportional to 1/T and the exact limiting one-dimensional bath entropy rate is T0*k^2*(1-sqrt(1-contrast^2))/(2*gamma). This tests the finite-mass kinetic reference independently of the positional entropy-current term.
public_wording_review: Final public README removed the diagnostic directive about the starter; apparatus, heat definition and limiting procedure remain unchanged.
